title: TAI bootstrap canonical image trigger
objective: Ensure every merged change to the owner-authorized TAI bootstrap preflight authority publishes canonical API, Web, Migration and TAI images for the same exact main SHA, so protected preflight and activation cannot deadlock on missing immutable image authority.
boundaries: The pull request performs no production mutation
Canonical images are published only by the existing main-push image authority after merge
The owner preflight, protected activation controller, exact-main checks, rollback and strict postflight remain unchanged
No inbound SSH, runner Docker authority, sudo capability, credential, tenant, role, model, database, financial or application-data authority is added
REG.RU only and zero new recurring cost
